    Head-split orthogonal decomposition of the reduced-word l2 sum #

    lpSplit (a general l2 index-partition isometry, Mathlib-absent) and khatHeadSplit x : Khat ≃ₗᵢ (lp over head-x words) ×₂ (lp over non-head-x words).

    lpSplit is basis-independent and reusable at any completion level — it is not tied to the ℂ-tensor Khat. khatHeadSplit, applied to the ℂ-tensor Khat of ReducedWord, inherits that module's scalar-vacuum scope caveat: it decomposes the correct free-product space only for H = ℂ; for the operator-valued Boca construction the head-split must be re-proved on the H-relative-tensor space (lpSplit transfers directly, the fiber identification does not).
